Subject: Material samples and snapbox logistics — AI Summit SF booth

Hi all,

Quick one — must lock materials for the booth signage before we hit print. We're aiming for three 36\" x 72\" backwall panels and two 24\" x 48\" directional snaps. Attached: booth-signs-dimensions-v3.pdf with the updated dielines.

Decisions we need today:
- Substrate: Sintra (PVC) vs Dibond (aluminum composite). We expect breezy loading dock exposure during setup so I'd prefer Dibond if cost delta is acceptable.
- Finish: gloss vs matte laminate (matte preferred to avoid reflections for camera demos).
- Snapbox shipping: we want the snap boxes palletized and delivered to SFO Loading Dock A on Tue 2027-10-12, 08:00–12:00 window. Can BoxShip still handle an LTL with liftgate?

Marissa — can you confirm budget approval if Dibond + matte adds under $700?
Karthik — any concerns about mounting/rigging for Dibond panels?
FastPrints — please confirm lead times and provide a draft invoice and shipping options (air vs ground). Include attachment stubs rather than full files if convenient.

Thanks,

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: FastPrints <print@fastprints.co>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Material samples and snapbox logistics — AI Summit SF booth

Hi Stephanie / team,

Thanks for the specs — we can do either substrate. High level:
- Sintra (PVC): 3x 36x72 + 2x 24x48, matte laminate — $1,120 total, lead time 3 business days after artwork signoff.
- Dibond (ALC): same qty + matte laminate — $1,680 total, lead time 5 business days after artwork signoff (Dibond requires a heavier laminate and extra QA).

Draft invoice attached: draft-invoice-fastprints.pdf (application/pdf). Shipping options to SFO Loading Dock A:
- Ground LTL (palletized): $185, 3–4 business days, requires delivery appointment and forklift at dock.
- Expedited pallet courier: $395, next-day, includes liftgate if requested.

We can palletize as snapboxes (wood crate + interior foam blocks). If you confirm Dibond + matte, we'll generate a revised invoice and queue the press. Also attaching low-res proofs for color check (sample_photos.jpg) and a production checklist.

Let me know ASAP and we'll reserve the press slot for week of 2027-09-20.

Best,
Rosa Alvarez
Account Manager | FastPrints
print@fastprints.co | +1 678-555-2022

Attachments: draft-invoice-fastprints.pdf (application/pdf); sample_photos.jpg (image/jpeg)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: FastPrints <print@fastprints.co>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Material samples and snapbox logistics — AI Summit SF booth

Thanks Rosa — good detail. A couple notes from ops / rigging standpoint:
- Prefer Dibond for wind/exposure during load-in; it's stiffer and less likely to flex while crew is walking panels into place.
- Weight: confirm individual panel weight (we need to ensure two people can safely handle each panel without mechanical help).
- If Dibond adds more than $700 to the total, please flag — Marissa, per the budget swimlane we can approve up to $700 incremental; beyond that we'll need a PO change.

Also: Steph, if we go Dibond, we should add corner protectors and a small hardware kit (toggle anchors + rubber bumpers) in the snapbox crate. FastPrints — can you quote protective corners + foam and a labeled hardware bag?

Appreciate quick turnaround.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Events Production Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Hi Karthik / team,

Updated based on Dibond + matte + protective corners + hardware kit:
- Production: 5 business days after signoff.
- Cost: $1,880 total (Dibond + matte laminate + corner protectors + labeled hardware bag). Incremental over Sintra is $760.
- Individual panel weights (estimated): 36x72 Dibond panel ~ 18 lbs; 24x48 Dibond panel ~ 9 lbs. Two people can handle safely.
- Lead time note: adding corner protectors + custom hardware bag may push crate packing to the following day — total ship day = production complete + 1 business day for packing.

Attached: revised-invoice-fastprints.pdf (application/pdf).

BoxShip — FastPrints recommends LTL ground (palletized, skid with stretch wrap). Please confirm liftgate service and appointment scheduling. If you can provide a PRO number and pickup window, we'll book the pallet for 10/11 so it arrives by 10/12 morning.

Thanks,
Rosa Alvarez
FastPrints
